lines.text: Welcome.\c\nMy name is Erika.\nI am the Gym Leader of the Celadon City Gym.
I am a student of the art of flower arranging.\c\nMy Pokémon are all of the Grass type.
...Oh, I’m sorry.\nDid you perhaps wish to challenge me?
Very well...\nbut I shall not lose.
I must confer on you a Rainbow Badge.
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Rainbow Badge[VAR COLOR(0000)] from Erika!

A Rainbow Badge raises the level of Pokémon
willing to listen to you to Lv. [VAR NUM2(0004)], for Pokémon
that you have received from other Trainers.\c
And...here.
If you’d like, please also take this with you.
You got [VAR ITEM2(0001)] [VAR COLOR(0006)][VAR MOVE(0002)][VAR COLOR(0000)] from Erika!

TM53 contains Mega Drain.\c
Half the damage it inflicts is drained from
the target to heal your Pokémon.\c
Wouldn’t you agree that it’s a wonderful move?

Oh my...
So you are cataloging the Pokémon you catch?
I must say I’m impressed.\c
I myself would never collect a Pokémon if it
were not beautiful.
